insights: YouTube Shorts dramatically outperform long-form videos on this channel, averaging over 800 views compared to under 100 views for long videos.

Space and aerospace topics (such as NASA, Artemis, and orbital mechanics) consistently achieve the highest view counts and retention rates, exemplified by the NASA Europa Clipper short hitting 1,293 views and 154.8% average view percentage.
Shorts using the 'Myth vs fact' style perform exceptionally well, achieving top scores including a 1.33 score for the Artemis III Moon Rocket video.
Videos structured around 'Shocking fact first' effectively drive high traffic, with multiple top-performing space and robotics shorts exceeding 1,000 views.
Viewer drop-off commonly occurs between the 5th and 9th seconds of shorts, frequently coinciding with technical exposition lines in the script.
Long-form videos suffer from extremely low initial click-through and reach (most under 20 views), indicating that current long-form titles and topics fail to attract initial audience interest.
